_notes: Labeled set for eval_code_lookup.py (issue #51). Each entry has a 'query' plus 'expected_codes': a non-empty list means at least one of these codes must appear in the top-5 retrieved results (top-5 recall) - the list has more than one entry only when multiple codes are genuinely, defensibly correct for that query (e.g. 'guns' matches every caliber-specific PSC code), not as a hedge. An empty list is a regression guard for a genuine no-match case: no candidate should clear RERANK_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD (singletons.py), matching what the real resolve_*_code tool would say.

'system' (naics/psc/cfda) is filled in by eval_code_lookup.py from the top-level key, not stored per-entry - it selects which of the three retrievers (_get_naics_retriever/_get_psc_retriever/_get_cfda_retriever) runs the query.
Every entry here was verified against the real, live-built local indices before being added (not guessed) - see the query results quoted in issue #51 and this eval's own PR description.
